judgement.reason: Khoj is a single-image web app on PostgreSQL, and its sandbox, computer and search services are optional add-ons, so a contained change is enough.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (sandbox, computer, server). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The computer service is optional and only used when KHOJ_OPERATOR_ENABLED is set, and the production image runs only the gunicorn server, though the sandbox service may still need vendor confirmation.

evidence.quote: # Set KHOJ_OPERATOR_ENABLED=True in the server service environment variable to enable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume khoj_computer:/home/operator (docker-compose.yml computer), volume khoj_config:/root/.khoj/ (docker-compose.yml server)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that the /root/.khoj/ config volume holds only a cache or data replaced by a managed service.
